strongest_objection: Once the predecessor has paid both children, all four of its distinctions are shared. A bounded physical inspection gives no automatic labels for its original two inputs. Supplying such labels could change the least access needed to recover its most recent signal.
response: Specified the root roles and the physical incidence, values and total holder counts at visited older knots. A pointer to the predecessor's original inputs is a separate control. Any minimum requires a decoder and an ambiguity at all smaller bounds. Clarified that enrollment ignores values while bindings may depend on the past. Corrected the archived field and function names.
final_decision: GO for exact freeze. The revision resolves the access ambiguity. It defines what the child can inspect after payment, treats a pointer to the predecessor’s original inputs as extra access, and requires both a decoder and matching lower bounds before claiming a minimum. It also preserves all lawful allocations while allowing a shared binding for the witness. This decision covers the prospective design only.
